purpose: Non-secret release credential map for Agentlas Desktop public releases.
source_of_truth: Agentlas Desktop/terminal owns this release credential contract because it owns local runtime packaging and macOS public release publishing.
raw_secret_policy: Do not commit raw secrets, certificates, tokens, passwords, OTPs, or private keys. This file stores names, locations, and validation commands only.

boundary.desktop_project: Keep the credential map, release workflow, release scripts, and signing README in this project.
boundary.appbridge: AppBridge may point to this map through architecture sync notes, but it must not store raw release secrets or become the credential source of truth.
boundary.github_actions: Store CI secret values only as repository secrets on agentlas-ai/agentlas-desktop.
boundary.local_machine: Store Apple signing files only in ignored signing/ files or a local keychain/notary profile.

local_secret_homes.path: local Railway CLI login and project link

credentials.name: Apple notarization account
credentials.local_source: notarytool profile agentlas-notary or APPLE_ID, APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID

credentials.name: Railway production web env publisher
credentials.local_source: railway login plus linked project agentlas / production / agentlas-web

failure_contract.mac_build_or_notarization_failed: No public macOS release should be marked ready.
failure_contract.railway_access_failed: macOS release may still publish, but web env publishing is skipped. Regenerate RAILWAY_TOKEN or grant it access to the project and service before relying on automatic web updates.
failure_contract.web_env_apply_failed_after_publish: GitHub release assets may exist, but https://agentlas.cloud/api/desktop/latest is not current until release:web-env succeeds and the web service restarts.
